name: Sumeragi Kouichi
source:
The player character. Despite being the son of a powerful politician, Kouichi was never one to bask in glory or temporal power. All he simply seeks is to lead an enjoyable life with friends and family. Nonetheless, his social status was too important for the powers that be to overlook, and in the end Kouichi is forced to accept a dilemma that is not easily escaped: an arranged marriage with an individual seen only as a cherished friend.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064424/http://www.elizar.com/?p=3]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
